description: Warehouse drone agent modeled on Section 2.3: reaches the top shelf and carries light items. Limits: Cannot carry heavy items or reach the middle shelf. Top-shelf retrieval only. Execution is simulated planning only; no hardware interface is connected. Capability does not grant access: protected resources require a valid, unrevoked permission for the authorized task interval.
name: Drone Agent

skills.name: Reach top shelf
skills.description: Model the physical capability to reach the top shelf; return a simulated retrieval plan, not hardware execution.
examples: Plan retrieving a light item from the top shelf.

skills.name: Carry light items
skills.description: Model transport of light items within the agent's shelf-reach limits. Heavy loads are unsupported; unspecified load classifications require clarification.
examples: Plan carrying a light item retrieved from the top shelf.
